occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Caregivers Licensed -24 hours Annual Training: During today's inspection, I observed 4 caregivers training records from 11/2024 - 11/2025). First caregiver (NR) only have 9.5 hours. Second caregiver (MW) 16 hours, 3rd caregiver (AW) 23.5 hours and Primary caregiver only has 14 hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Caregivers Licensed -24 hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training: During today's inspection, the prmary caregiver only able to find 14 hours training certification for (11/2024 - 11/2025).

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR: During the inspection, the provider could only find 2 CPR/First Aid certifications. She will text me the other 3 caregivers' certifications. On 8/24/2026, I did not receive the caregivers' CPR/First Aid certifications.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §747.1303(2)(A))
